meta.title: [Feature]: Sync with latest binding.js from napi-rs to fix performance issue
meta.body_summary: Sync binding.js with latest napi-rs to set process.report.excludeNetwork = true before getReport(), reducing isMusl() overhead from 5s to ~4ms on affected systems.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added process.report.excludeNetwork to isMusl in three files; PR closed after 19 days without merge, likely due to inactivity despite CI fix by agent.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 10 changed lines across 3 files, this is a trivial edit by absolute volume. As a small-step performance fix, its closure without merge despite low change volume is unexpected and may reflect process or evidence barriers.

review_details.concern_detail: PR was left without formal review; after CI fix, closed 18 days later by CPunisher without comment.
review_details.performance_claim: isMusl() overhead reduced from 5+ seconds to ~4ms by excluding network info from process.report.getReport().
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge after extended inactivity; no explicit rejection but no maintainer merged.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Trivial runtime fix with narrative performance claims; maintainer did not merge despite CI passing, possibly requiring benchmark evidence or reviewer approval.

detection_detail.code_reading: No code-reading review found; only a CI fix command.
detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions binary size-limit and other CI runs, but no performance-specific detection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides before/after timing numbers but no benchmark or reproduction script; maintainer did not verify.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix-in-pr cycle for performance regression, only a CI fix.

core_change_summary.description: In three binding.js/ts files, added process.report.excludeNetwork = true before calling process.report.getReport() in the isMusl() function to prevent network info collection overhead.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added process.report.excludeNetwork = true to isMusl in three files.
Subsequent commit: fixed TypeScript error in bindingVersionCheck.ts by adding @ts-expect-error annotation.
No further changes; PR left inactive and closed.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer instructed Copilot to fix CI error.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed TypeScript error and reported back.

review_signals.summary: Copilot reported fixing CI TypeScript error with @ts-expect-error, all checks pass.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with fix in three files.
Initial comments from bots (Netlify, CLA, size-limit) within first hour.
Next day, maintainer hardfist requested CI fix; Copilot added @ts-expect-error and confirmed fix.
No further human engagement; PR closed by CPunisher after 19 days without merge.
